         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>alle bewerteten Klausuren liegen der Abt. II-2 Studiensektretariat vor</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-FC7DD929-D2C2-4140-8983-F20AC5415834" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Alle Klausuren werden an einem zentralen Scan-PC in Abt. II-2 Studiensekretariat eingescannt (i.d.R. durch HiWi)
Dabei ist zu beachten:
- Klammern und/oder Büroklammern aus Klausuren entfernen
- Format beim Einlegen in Scanner beachten (A5 - A3)
- bereits bestehende Barcodes unkenntlich machen
</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-99CE1184-D5F7-4937-83F4-B9162EC79233" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Aufbewahrungsfrist:
6 Jahre ab Exmatrikulationsdatum</text>

expectedValues.reason: This activity involves manual data entry into a Document Management System (DMS), which is a structured process that follows defined rules. It requires strict adherence to data entry guidelines and uses structured data. The task is predictable and does not require creativity or complex interpretation.

The activity of scanning exams is performed using a scanning device and produces digital output, which can be automated as it follows consistent procedures and uses structured data. It does not involve complex decision-making or creativity.

This activity involves scanning exam papers with a high-performance scanner. Similar to the other scanning task, it is a physical-to-digital conversion using a specialized system. The operation is predictable, repetitive, and rule-based, suitable for automation when integrated with automated document handling.

This activity involves generating a barcode from the DMS, printing it on labels, and attaching it to personalized exam cover sheets. The generation and printing steps are system-based and rule-driven. However, the physical attachment of labels may require manual dexterity. The automatable parts are the barcode generation and printing, which are predictable, digital tasks.

This activity consists of importing a CSV file into the DMS, which follows clear and unambiguous rules. The data is structured, digital, and the process can be executed consistently, making it suitable for automation.

This task involves querying data from a Content Management System (CMS) and generating a CSV file, which is a structured data format. The rules for querying and file creation are well-defined and stable, and the interaction with the CMS can be automated, making it feasible for RPA.

expectedValues.reason: This activity involves the student filling out a form for exmatriculation, which can be performed using a digital form system. The rules for filling out the form are well-defined, stable, and use structured data. All necessary data is in digital format.

This task involves checking documents based on set criteria, which can be automated. The rules for what constitutes a complete application are well-defined and the necessary data is structured and available digitally.
Reversing an exmatriculation can be automated as it involves following clear and stable rules, using structured data that is available digitally.
Executing the exmatriculation is a task that can be automated as it follows strict rules and uses structured data. All necessary information is in digital format and the execution context is stable.
This task involves deleting an acceptance based on fixed dates, which can be automated. The rules are clear, stable, and all necessary data is in digital format.
This activity involves requesting missing documents, which can be automated based on clear rules and structured data. The process is stable and predictable, making it suitable for automation.

This task involves completing required documents, which typically follows a set of clear and structured guidelines. It can be automated as the requirements are stable and the data is likely to be in digital formats.

      <textAnnotation id="sid-6B11154D-06F0-4FD7-8EFA-EF24424E5BA5" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>alle bewerteten Klausuren liegen der Abt. II-2 Studiensektretariat vor</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-FC7DD929-D2C2-4140-8983-F20AC5415834" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Alle Klausuren werden an einem zentralen Scan-PC in Abt. II-2 Studiensekretariat eingescannt (i.d.R. durch HiWi)
Dabei ist zu beachten:
- Klammern und/oder Büroklammern aus Klausuren entfernen
- Format beim Einlegen in Scanner beachten (A5 - A3)
- bereits bestehende Barcodes unkenntlich machen
</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-99CE1184-D5F7-4937-83F4-B9162EC79233" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Aufbewahrungsfrist:
6 Jahre ab Exmatrikulationsdatum</text>
      </textAnnotation>
